column1: # Xuan Yuan Sword 7: Unreal Engine 4.25.0, SDK 17.5.3, NVN; base game 1.0.0 (v0).
# Mac bring-up from the NSP script's provisional profile; see README.md for evidence and limits.

# Unreal's generic engine-region cap and FMallocBinned3 host allocator, plus SDK 17.5.3's registered node-area and 1 GB-to-32 MB alignment cuts, fit the 4.06 GB engine region in this 4.375 GB alias region. The 75 s startup probe passed the former abort but remained at the Playerium splash. A follow-up interactive Mac probe continued an existing save from the title into the 3D house scene, reached frame 6600 and mapped alias pages up to +1.50 GB; the reserved engine region ends at +4.125 GB. iPhone launch and gameplay remain untested (docs/reference/memory.md; see Games/xys7/input/010029F01BA3E000_build/ios-probe/formalinteractive/layout.ok)
# the NPDM declares 80 MB of system resource
# A free camera on the right stick; docked operation mode, 3D controller layout.
# the decoded shader code archives: the engine's global shaders and the game's material shaders
# the game calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode with near = 0 in the check boot: the pipeline bases made before it runs are made for that mode
